shortDescription: BASF XETR:BAS sued Apple NASDAQ:AAPL on Thursday, accusing the iPhone maker of infringing the German company's patented face authentication technology in dozens of iPhone and iPad models.The complaint was filed in the U.S. District Court in Midland, Texas.
